description: IRVE SDEC23 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Départemental des Energies de la Creuse. Charging Infrastructures for Electric Vehicles on the Creuse Department Managed by SDEC23 (Departmental Union of Creuse Energies) Network of public charging stations deployed and operated by the Syndicat Départemental des Energies de la Creuse. The SDIRVE was officially validated by the Prefecture in June 2022. Coverage: Syndicat Départemental des Energies de la Creuse. The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Départemental des Energies de la Creuse. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
